meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
lease.title: Lease the {name}
lease.downPaymentFixed: This item can only be leased with a down payment of {amount}.
lease.vatNote: VAT is charged at the rate valid on each invoice date. Your rent excl. VAT stays locked.
lease.buyout: Buy it at the end for
lease.totalCostNote: Down payment plus all monthly rents. Buying it at the end is optional.
lease.bandHint: Tip: with {down} down your rent is {saving} lower per month. Financing a little more puts you in a cheaper pricing band.
lease.signNote: Signing locks this price for the whole lease. Price list changes after today won't affect it.
lease.error: The contract could not be signed. Please try again.
lease.errorTaken: Someone has just leased this item. Please choose another.
lease.notLeasable.reserved: This item is reserved and can't be leased right now.
lease.notLeasable.returned: This item has come back and is being prepared for its next life.
lease.notLeasable.below_minimum: This item costs less than the 300 € minimum we can finance.
lease.notLeasable.no_price: This item has no price today.
contract.title: Contract {id}
contract.lockedNote: Priced on {date} from price list {version}. This price was locked when you signed: later price lists can't change it.
contract.billingRule: Billed in advance on the start day each month, a full month at a time. In a shorter month the invoice is due on its last day.
contract.vatChanged: From {date} VAT is {rate} %. Your rent stays the same; only the tax changes.
audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: Every change to contracts and items, newest first.
why.q_full_name: The contract is made in your name.
why.q_birth_date: You must be 18 or older to sign a lease.
why.q_email: Invoices and the contract are sent here.
why.q_country: We can lease only to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
why.q_employment: Helps us check the rent fits your budget.
why.q_monthly_income: Rent may be at most 30 % of net income for consumers.
why.q_business_id: Identifies the business that signs the contract.
why.q_company_name: Printed on the contract and invoices.
why.q_can_sign: Only an authorised signatory can make the contract binding.
why.q_signatory_email: We send the contract to them for signing.
why.q_vat_registered: Changes how we show prices: with or without VAT.
why.q_usage_purpose: Delivery use wears the bike faster and changes the end-of-term check.
why.q_farm_registry: Farm machines are leased to registered farms or contractors.
why.q_annual_revenue: Required for leases of 50,000 EUR or more.
why.q_beneficial_owners: Anti-money-laundering law requires us to know who owns the business.
why.q_pep: Required by anti-money-laundering law for leases of 10,000 EUR or more.
why.q_pep_details: A politically exposed person needs a manual check by a person, not a rule.
application.title: Apply
application.intro: We only ask what this lease needs. Change the term or down payment and the questions update.
application.dropped: Some earlier answers no longer apply to this lease, so we've set them aside.
application.remaining: Answer the questions above to see the decision.
error.not_an_option: Please choose one of the options.
error.invalid_email: Please enter an email address like name@example.com.
error.invalid_money: Please enter an amount in euros, for example 3200 or 3200,50.
error.invalid_business_id: This business ID's check digit doesn't match. Please check the number, for example 1234567-1.
outcome.manual_review: A person will check your application
outcome.approved.text: You can sign the contract now.
outcome.manual_review.text: We can't decide this automatically. Someone from our team will review it, usually within one working day.
reason.min_age: You need to be {minAge} on the day the lease starts. You can apply from {date}, and we'd be glad to see you then.
reason.blocked_answer.q_country: We can only lease to people living in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
reason.affordability: The highest monthly total during the lease, {rent}, is more than 30 % of your net income ({max} at most). A longer term or a down payment lowers the monthly rent.
reason.pep_manual_review: Anti-money-laundering rules say applications from politically exposed persons are always checked by a person.
signer.signatory: Only an authorised signatory can sign for the company, so you can't sign here. We'll send the contract to {email} to sign.

catalogue.heroTitle: Every item has more than one life
catalogue.statSecondLife: on a second life or more
lease.notLeasable.sold: This item has been bought by its last lessee.
end.title: End of term
end.dates: Your lease covers up to {lastDay}. You can choose what happens next from {opensOn}, the start of your final month. The handover is on {handover}.
end.notYet: You can make your choice from {date}.
end.choose: What would you like to do?
end.text.buy: Pay the buyout locked when you signed: {net} excl. VAT. VAT is charged at the rate on the handover day, {rate} %, so you pay {gross}.
end.text.return: Hand it back. We note its condition and usage, then get it ready for its next life.
end.text.pass_on: Hand it back and name who should lease it next. They get first claim when it is offered again.
end.usageHint: At least {value}, the reading when you received it.
end.error: We couldn't save your choice. Please try again.
end.reason.usage_went_down: Usage cannot be lower than when you received the item.
end.reason.condition_improved: The condition cannot be better than when you received the item ({condition}).
end.reason.next_lessee_is_current: Please name someone other than yourself.
end.reason.too_early: You can make your choice from {date}.
end.reason.no_vat_rate: There is no VAT rate for the handover day yet.
end.reason.invalid_email: Please enter an email address like name@example.com.
end.done.buy: You bought the item. Ownership passes to you on {date}.
end.done.pass_on: You passed the item on to {name} on {date}.
